plan.comment: Requests: designer 174 asks me to rule on commit hashes inside drawings (convention 8 is mine): accept its proposal, a hash stays only where the commit itself is what the drawing shows, and comes off where it is only a 'read at' note; put it in convention 8; letter to the designer, the researcher and the conductor. Writes only chapter-plan/, team/storyteller/, comms/mail/storyteller/ and mailroom storyteller__* letters.

pre_review.comment: Within policy; no HOLD.md; hashes are public. Convention 8 cites brief 13 and the designer's 137, no signed hash decision, so the rule is the storyteller's to set.
